tanya (People Ops): Hi @jordan — quick Q re: adding an adult dependent midyear. You mentioned you're now a court-appointed guardian for your niece. We can do a QLE add but need specific docs. Can you confirm which proof you have?
jordan carter: Hey! I have the temporary guardianship order dated 2026-02-10 and a letter from the county social services. Is that enough?
tanya (People Ops): Usually a court order or final guardianship is ideal, but temporary orders + a social services letter can work for provisional enrollment. We'll need the docs uploaded to the portal within 30 days of the QLE.
jordan carter: Great — how do I upload? Any filename/format limits?
benefits-bot: @jordan carter You can upload via the HR portal: https://hr.redwood-inference.com/benefits/upload or through the Benefits tab in the employee console. Accepted formats: PDF, JPG, PNG. Max file size 10MB. Recommended filename: lastname_firstname_documenttype.pdf
samir khan: cc @tanya — if payroll needs retro pay adjustments for premiums, what's the cutoff? Jordan, this will affect your deductions so heads up.
tanya (People Ops): Good point @samir. If docs are submitted within 30 days of the QLE effective date, benefits will be effective retro to the QLE and payroll will be adjusted back to that date. If after 30 days, coverage may start at the next payroll cycle and retro pay might not be possible.
jordan carter: OK uploading now. One more: do I need dependent SSN for enrollment? The temporary guardianship order redacts the minor's SSN in the doc we have.
tanya (People Ops): We do ask for dependent SSN for the carrier enrollment, but if a document redacts it, submit a redacted doc plus a separate secure message with the SSN to benefits@redwood-inference.com or use the secure upload form on the portal (checkbox "sensitive info"). Benefits-bot will mark it for secure handling.
benefits-bot: Upload path (copy/paste): 1) Sign in > Benefits > Manage Dependents > Add Dependent > Add Dependent > "Upload Proof". 2) Choose "Guardianship / Court Order". 3) Check "Contains sensitive info" if SSN included. Example UI snippet: ```Manage Dependents -> Add -> Upload -> Select document -> Confirm```
jordan carter: Done — I uploaded two files: guardianship_temp_20260210.pdf and county_letter_20260208.jpg. Also sent SSN via secure form.
hr-portal-bot: Received documents. Case #B-2026-489 created. Please allow 3 business days for verification. If additional docs are needed Benefits team will follow up.
tanya (People Ops): Thanks @jordan — once verified we'll confirm effective date and any payroll adjustments. If anything urgent, DM me. :thumbsup:
